# Notices of the packages in this folder

The core's scripts run these packages of other publishers, each in the folder of its name beside this file, its files
taken unchanged from its registry's tarball (`list.json`; `scripts/third-party.mjs`). Each is under its own licence,
whose text travels in its folder, and not under the core's: the core's `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` cover none of them.
